This app enables anonymous usage statistics by default to understand active device counts and feature usage. We collect app version, language, deck, and the number of cards drawn; we do not collect questions, specific draw results, or local history. The server temporarily reads the connection IP for rate limiting and abuse prevention. Of network-address and location data, the statistics database stores only the country code and the first-level subdivision code and name inferred by Cloudflare from the connection IP; it does not store the raw IP address, an IP digest, a city, or more precise location data. These location fields may be missing or inaccurate and do not represent the user\'s actual residence. Active-install counts are estimates based on periodic sampling of a random per-install identifier, not exact user numbers. You can turn it off below at any time; turning it off stops sending every statistics event (including the app_active version reports) and deletes this device\'s anonymous identifier. Announcement checks and update checks are not statistics and may still use the network while statistics are off.
Usage statistics stopped and the anonymous identifier was deleted
